caseNameFull: Common Cause v. Schmitt and Federal Election Commission v. Americans for Change

opinions.text: D. C. D. C. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 450 U. S. 908.] Motions of appellants for divided argument and for additional time for oral argument granted. A total of one and one-half hours is allotted for oral argument to be divided as follows: 25 minutes for Federal Election Commission; 20 minutes for Common Cause et al.; and 45 minutes for appellees.
